provenance.host: one temporary GitHub-hosted VM per platform (ubuntu-latest Linux-X64, ubuntu-24.04-arm Linux-ARM64, macos-15 macOS-ARM64); on each, toolu and the official runner register by JIT with per-run labels, run side by side as separate processes in isolated homes, and share that VM's Docker daemon (Linux only). Per-platform image, Docker and binary identities are under `platforms` (recorded by each VM's host report).

official.registration: unmodified release archive, config.sh by JIT (generate-jitconfig) with the per-run lane label; run.sh

toolu.build: cargo build -p toolu-runner --bin toolu-runner --features capture (debug profile), built on each VM
toolu.registration: JIT from generate-jitconfig with the per-run lane label; `run` always-online loop, forwarder services mode; plus -pool second runners, toolu-only fresh (two consecutive jobs) and ephemeral lifecycle registrations

provenance.normalized: only the lane token in job names; step names, conclusions and observation values are compared verbatim
